facts.statement: The genus Placodus was first described by Agassiz in 1833.
The family Placodontidae was established by Cope in 1871.
Fossils of Placodus have been found in Central Europe, including Germany, France, and Poland, as well as in China.
facts.quote: Fossils of Placodus have been found in Central Europe (Germany, France, Poland) and China.

facts.statement: Placodus lived during the Middle Triassic, approximately 240 million years ago.
facts.quote: que vivieron en el Triásico Medio (hace cerca de 240 millones de años).

facts.statement: Placodus possessed a short neck and a heavy skull.
facts.quote: It had a short neck, and a heavy skull.

facts.statement: Placodus was specialized for a durophagous diet consisting of shellfish like bivalves.
facts.quote: They were specialized for a durophagous diet of shellfish, such as bivalves.

facts.statement: The back teeth were broad and flattened, helping to crush prey.
facts.quote: The back teeth were broad and flattened, and would have helped to crush the prey.

facts.statement: Before their full anatomy was known, Placodus fossils were mistaken for fish teeth.
facts.quote: Before the animals' anatomy was known, they were regarded as fishes' teeth.

facts.statement: Flattened tails and short legs, likely ending in webbed feet, served as the main means of propulsion in water.
facts.quote: Their flattened tails and short legs, which probably ended in webbed feet, would have been their main means of propulsion in the water.

facts.statement: The vertebral processes dove-tailed and connected firmly, making the trunk rigid.
facts.quote: The vertebral processes of Placodus dove-tailed into each other and were firmly connected, so that the trunk was rigid.

facts.statement: The abdomen was covered with special armor formed by bent, right-angled abdominal ribs.
facts.quote: The abdomen was covered with a special armor formed of the bent, right-angled abdominal ribs.

facts.statement: Molluscs, brachiopods, crustaceans, and other seafloor inhabitants formed a regular part of its diet.
facts.quote: Los moluscos, braquiópodos, crustáceos y otros habitantes del fondo marino hubiera sido parte regular de su dieta.

facts.statement: The species P. gigas (Agassiz, 1833) is the type species, and P. inexpectatus was described by Jiang et al. in 2008.
facts.quote: subdivision: P. gigas Agassiz, 1833 (especie tipo) P. inexpectatus Jiang et al., 2008

facts.statement: There are 34 recorded fossil occurrences of the genus Placodus.
